notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Faceless One for {0} due to Rakdos.
description:
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
